plugin.name: The Saboteur Fusion Fix
FixFOV.description: Widen the camera's field of view on screens wider than 4:3 (Hor+).
WindowMode.description: The window when the game's own fullscreen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
FPSLimit.description: Limit the frame rate; the fix's timing corrections for driving, the clock and the mouse use it. 0 removes the limit and those corrections.
ConsoleGamma.description: Use the gamma of the Xbox 360 version.
AntiAliasing.description: SMAA anti-aliasing, applied before the HUD is drawn.
